description: The math arm for LLMs: compute and check numbers from CSV and Excel tables in Python, every number computed by pandas, SciPy and statsmodels with its calculation and rows, or refused with a reason. Tool definitions for function calling (ada.tools) for Claude, Codex and open-source models run with Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp or LM Studio; an MCP server (ada mcp) and a chat command (ada chat); a check of any number stated about a table; and a map of a folder of files.
rules: Give a language model ADA's tools with ada.tools.definitions() (or 'anthropic' style) and run its calls with ada.tools.run(name, arguments, root=folder); send back the JSON it returns.
Let ADA compute the numbers: report what it prints, with the calculation and rows it names, instead of computing or estimating them yourself.
Check every number you state about a data file with ada claim (or ada.check_claim) and report verified or unverified with ADA's reason; never call a whole answer verified because one number was.
When a check comes back missing_context or ambiguous_intent, ask the person ADA's clarification question instead of choosing a reading.
For a folder of files, run ada scan first and confirm the proposed links, row meanings and units with the person before combining files.
